facts.business: Bannari Amman Spinning Mills Limited is an integrated textile company engaged in the manufacture of cotton yarn, knitted & woven fabrics, processing of fabrics, finished garments, home textiles and wind power generation.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property plant and equipment, including capital advances

key_risks: Inventory valuation involves significant level of subjectivity, judgment and estimation due to diversified range and quality of yarn, fabric and garments
